title: Turn an advertising strategy into your next action.
summary: Bring a strategy from the PostPlus library to your agent. Adjust its goals and rules, review account evidence, and carry out supported actions within your authorization. PostPlus now offers 28 advertising strategy templates: https://postplus.io/ad-strategy. Choose a strategy and copy its prompt to your agent.
highlights: Explore 28 advertising strategy templates at https://postplus.io/ad-strategy, covering performance monitoring, budget adjustments, stop loss, and creative testing.
Apply copied strategies with platform-specific metrics and action guidance.
Preserve your selected goals, budget limits and execution mode.
Verify changed objects after supported account actions; recurring execution requires a configured scheduler.
After installing or updating PostPlus, continue your original task.
